item.title: Glide Floating 22cm - 120g
item.excerpt:
The new model of our classic floating for tuna and gt.

22cm and 120g of weight, is the standard stick we often use, especially on single tuna or looking for gt.

Best hook setup: 4/0 or 5/0 treble in front and back or inline hooks bkk diablo 13/0 (or same weight) front and back

prevItem.title: Glide Floating 18cm - 75g
prevItem.excerpt:
A PE5 to 8 floating stick of 18 cm and 75g of weight.

Very pleasant to use when armed with a front treble hook, frantic swimming, it feels very good in the tip of the rod during the action.

Best hook setup: 3/0 or 4/0 treble in front and inline hooks bkk diablo 9/0 or same weight back.

nextItem.title: Glide Floating 24cm - 150g
nextItem.excerpt:
The new model our classic floating 24cm and 150g of weight.

If you start looking for big fish it is right to use this stick. Big tuna or gt is the target, very frantic and precise swimming are the main characteristics.

Best hook setup: 5/0 treble in front and back or very big hooks front and rear.
